name: SMT101x Sensors
description: Two modes for SMT101x tablets: recover the OEM publisher using your existing external MQTT settings, or manage sensors, switches, doors, and RGB backlight through Kiosk Satellite using the built-in local broker, with no separate MQTT server required.
author: Stuart Pearson

settings.title: Automatically re-enable disabled tablet MQTT
settings.description: In either mode, allows automatic recovery to turn Android Settings > System > MQTT back on and start the OEM publisher when MQTT is disabled. Requires automatic recovery to be enabled. Checks once per minute, with a five-minute cooldown after recovery attempts; local mode also waits for the built-in broker to be listening. Reopen Android System settings to see the updated switch; enabled does not guarantee a healthy connection. Leave off to respect intentional MQTT disables. The server address, port, credentials, and client ID are not changed.

settings.title: Automatically recover stopped OEM MQTT publisher
settings.description: Works with either your existing external MQTT server or the built-in local broker. Checks the OEM publisher once per minute and restarts it if stopped, including after Wi-Fi interruptions or updates that stop the process. Local mode waits for the broker to be listening. Does not restart a running but disconnected client, verify external delivery, or repair network, authentication, or server problems. Disabled MQTT is respected unless automatic re-enabling is selected. Recovery attempts have a five-minute cooldown; connection settings are unchanged.

settings.title: Host MQTT capture broker on this tablet
settings.description: On: local sensor management through Kiosk Satellite. Set Android Settings > System > MQTT to server 127.0.0.1 and port 1883; the built-in broker receives readings and sends switch and RGB commands, so no separate MQTT server is needed. Off: external MQTT recovery mode; keep your existing tablet MQTT settings and enable automatic recovery. External readings and controls are not bridged into Kiosk Satellite. This setting does not change the tablet's MQTT address automatically; the local broker accepts only connections from this tablet.

settings.title: MQTT client ID (optional)
settings.description: Must match client_id in the tablet's MQTT settings, for example office. The OEM client uses this value as its MQTT topic prefix. Leave blank to learn it automatically from status publications.
